name: Heartleaf Slap
description: Slap the opponent's guard aside with an open palm edged by a heart-shaped leaf of qi.

name: Heartleaf Screen
description: Hold two broad leaves of qi before the chest to cover the heart against a thrust.

name: Heartleaf Mend
description: Press a warm heartleaf of qi to an ally's wound until bleeding stops and the edges meet.

name: Leaf Cutter
description: Cut across the opponent's arm with a leaf of qi as sharp as a razor.

name: Heartleaf Veil
description: Flutter a curtain of paired leaves between the user and the opponent to hide which hand will strike.

name: Heart Draw
description: Draw an ally's pain into the user's own leaf of qi and let the wound close behind it.

name: Heartleaf Storm
description: Whirl a storm of sharp heart-shaped leaves around the user to cut all who stand near.

name: Heartleaf Ward
description: Wrap the user and one ally in a close fall of overlapping leaves that turns blows aside.

name: Healing Heartrain
description: Call down a soft rain of heart-shaped leaves that settles on every ally nearby and closes their wounds.

name: Twinheart Bloom
description: Open two linked hearts of qi in bloom over the opponent that cut and spread the school's twin flowering.

name: Yew Rap
description: Rap a knuckle of dense yew qi against the opponent's wrist or collarbone.

name: Yewbark Guard
description: Hold a dark scaly layer of yewbark qi over the forearms against a cut.

name: Yew Splinter
description: Flick a bitter yew splinter at the opponent's hand so it stings and swells.

name: Bitter Edge
description: Draw a bitter yew edge across the opponent's guard so the cut stings long after.

name: Yew Wrap
description: Wrap dark yew strands about the opponent's limbs that tighten as they strain.

name: Counter Sap
description: Turn the bitter sap of the yew against a poison in an ally's blood and drive it out.

name: Yewvenom Mist
description: Breathe out a low mist of yew venom that clings to the ground and sickens all who walk through.

name: Yew Aegis
description: Cloak the user in dense yew qi so tough that blades dull and blows lose their weight.

name: Yew Reckoning
description: Bring a trunk of black yew down on the opponent so the bitter poison follows the blow into the body.

name: Yewcourt Judgement
description: Deliver the school's closing stroke of the dark yew that weighs the guard and breaks it in one blow.

name: Ashstaff Jab
description: Jab a pole of straight ash qi from the shoulder into the gap in the guard.

name: Ash Guard
description: Hold a pale shaft of ash qi across the body to stop a heavy cut.

name: Ash Step
description: Pole off the ground with a shaft of ash qi to land a long pace away.

name: Ash Current
description: Run two streams of ash qi down the arms and strike with both in a single surge.

name: Ash Binding
description: Wind flexible ash strips round the opponent's body and tighten them through each breath.

name: Ash Mend
description: Splint and heal an ally's broken limb with straight bands of ash qi.

name: Meeting Boughs
description: Swing two great boughs round from either side so they meet on the opponent's body.

name: Ashen Shroud
description: Cover the user in a pale shroud of ash qi that muffles and turns hard blows.

name: Ashen Verdict
description: Bring a great ash trunk down in a stroke that ends the exchange.

name: Twinash
description: Join the two streams of ash qi at one point in the closing stroke of the school.

name: Oak Fist
description: Punch with a fist as hard and heavy as an oak knot.

name: Acorn Shot
description: Hurl an acorn of dense qi at the opponent's face so it cracks like a stone.

name: Oakbark Brace
description: Set the body behind a thick corrugated layer of oak qi that takes a hard blow.

name: Oak Swing
description: Swing a heavy oak limb of qi across the opponent with the weight of the whole body.

name: Oakroot Hold
description: Pin the opponent's feet with thick oak roots that cannot be torn loose by main strength.

name: Acorn Tonic
description: Feed an ally the dense stored strength of acorn qi to rebuild flesh and wind.

name: Oak Dive
description: Drop from height with a driven oak limb braced before the body.

name: Oakheart Shell
description: Close an unbroken shell of oakheart qi around the body that holds through a long fight.

name: Oak Plunge
description: Hurl the whole weight of an ancient oak down on the opponent in a plunging blow.

name: Oakhawk
description: Dive like a hawk with the full strength of the basin oak behind the school's closing stroke.

name: Crown Twig
description: Stab a stiff twig from the topmost crown of qi into a joint of the opponent.

name: Crown Shield
description: Raise a wide green crown of qi above the head to take a blow from the sky.

name: Crown Draw
description: Draw bright sunlit qi down through the crown into an ally's chest and limbs.

name: Crown Lash
description: Whip the tip of the highest bough in a long curving lash at the opponent.

name: Crown Snare
description: Drop a loop of high branches over the opponent and haul it tight.

name: Crown Mend
description: Rain warm crown qi on an ally to close wounds and restore lost strength.

name: Crown Bloom
description: Burst the crown into bloom so a wide ring of flower blades flies outward.

name: Crown Aegis
description: Hold the full crown over the user and nearby allies against a long barrage.

name: Crownwood Fall
description: Bring down the whole crown of the great tree on the opponent in a single falling stroke.

name: Highest Flowering
description: Raise the school's great flowering from the highest bough so the bloom cuts a wide arc of sky.

name: Larch Needle
description: Flick a soft larch needle hardened with qi at the opponent's eye.

name: Larch Guard
description: Hold a fine web of larch needles before the chest to catch and turn a blow.

name: Larch Step
description: Drift with the wind on soft larch needles of qi and land lightly aside.

name: Larch Whip
description: Whip a feathery larch bough of qi across the opponent's face and shoulders.

name: Needle Fall
description: Shake out a fall of hard needles that sting everyone in a short front.

name: Larch Resin
description: Smear amber larch resin over an ally's wound so it seals hard and clean.

name: Larch Tempest
description: Raise a gale of needles that scour the whole front in a spiral.

name: Larch Veil
description: Drop a dense golden veil of needles that holds off the wind and the blows within it.

name: Larch Rising
description: Raise new green growth through the allies in reach and fill their limbs with fresh spring strength.

name: Sworn Larch
description: Loose the sworn larch's closing stroke where the needles fall and rise again in one sweep.

name: Juniper Jab
description: Drive a fist wrapped in prickly juniper qi into the opponent's side.

name: Rockroot Guard
description: Wedge roots of qi into the rock beneath and hold the guard against a push.

name: Juniper Berry
description: Press a dark berry of qi to an ally's wound to ease the pain and draw it closed.

name: Rocksplit
description: Wedge a root of qi into the opponent's guard and split it with a hard twist.

name: Juniper Smoke
description: Waft pungent juniper smoke over an ally to clear a curse or clinging taint.

name: Root Pin
description: Pin the opponent's foot to the stone with a root driven through the gaps.

name: Granite Root
description: Drive a root as hard as granite up through the ground and the opponent's guard.

name: Juniper Shell
description: Pull close a shell of gnarled juniper qi that no edge can find a way into.

name: Rockbreak Root
description: Heave a root the size of a trunk through stone and guard to break both.

name: Oathrock
description: Stand on the sworn root in the rock and hold fast through the school's closing guard.

name: Hawthorn Prick
description: Prick the opponent's hand with a hawthorn spur of qi grown from the knuckle.

name: Haw Berry
description: Give an ally a red berry of qi to eat that steadies the heart and closes small wounds.

name: Thorn Bracer
description: Strap a bracer of hawthorn spurs to the forearm that pierces any hand that grips it.

name: Hawthorn Whip
description: Lash a spurred bough of qi across the opponent and drag the spurs back through the flesh.

name: Haw Snare
description: Cast a tangle of spurred twigs about the opponent that bites at every move.

name: Thorn Counter
description: Grow thorns where the blow lands so the attacker's own force drives them into them.

name: Thornwind
description: Loose a gale of spurs that sweep the whole front.

name: Bearing Thorn
description: Drive a long straight thorn along the held bearing through the opponent's guard.

name: Thorncrown
description: Grow a crown of great thorns round the body that hurls every blow back with its own force.

name: Galethorn Verdict
description: Hurl the school's closing thorn on the gale so it finds the opponent wherever they stand.

name: Alder Bough
description: Swing a pliant alder bough of qi across the opponent's flank.

name: Alder Bend
description: Bend with the blow like an alder in wind and let it pass over the shoulder.

name: Alder Pulse
description: Feel the sway of leaves and roots nearby and read the stir of those who walk among them.

name: Sway Lash
description: Swing the whole body in a wide sway and whip the bough round on the returning bend.

name: Alder Root Hold
description: Hold the opponent's feet with reddish alder roots rising out of wet ground.

name: Alder Cure
description: Draw cool healing qi along the alder's roots into an ally and mend torn flesh.

name: Alder Storm
description: Thrash a stand of alder limbs of qi in a storm that scours the whole front.

name: Alder Screen
description: Draw a swaying screen of alder boughs that bends and returns under every blow.

name: Alder Tempest
description: Whip a tempest of huge alder limbs through the whole space round the user.

name: Alderstorm Sway
description: Carry the great sway of the sworn alder from the first bend to the full storm in one sweep.

name: Banyan Root
description: Drop pillar roots from the arms to the ground to prop the stance against a blow.

name: Hanging Root
description: Swing from a hanging root of qi to a spot behind the opponent.

name: Banyan Sap
description: Give an ally the milky healing sap of the banyan to close a cut or bruise.

name: Banyan Strike
description: Bring a broad low limb of banyan qi across the opponent's body.

name: Banyan Net
description: Cast a net of hanging roots about the opponent that thicken and fix as they struggle.

name: Banyan Shade
description: Hold an ally in the cool shade of the banyan until taint and fever drain away.

name: Banyan Spread
description: Throw roots and limbs out in every direction at once in a spreading crush.

name: Banyan Pillar
description: Raise a ring of pillar roots about the user and allies that carries the load of any blow.

name: Banyan Return
description: Draw a still person back with the banyan's slow roots of life before the window of breath closes.

name: Banyan Eternal
description: Stand as the great banyan that no gale can tear from its ground in the school's closing guard.
